text:
morgan: Quick sync — APAC region roll planned Wed 2025-09-10 02:00 UTC. Need owners for: 1) regional routing policy rollout (traffic steering + fallbacks) 2) data residency verification for S3 buckets and logs 3) cert rotation + DNS change window 4) KV cache invalidation across edge nodes. Can owners ack? Tracking ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFR-624

kevin: I can take DNS + certs. Will schedule short maintenance window 01:30-02:15 UTC. Ping me for ACME details. :thumbsup:

anya: I'll own data residency tests. Need list of buckets + retention policies. @morgan can you attach the manifest? Also any PII test dataset requirements?

liz: Eng-SRE — we'll review routing policy. @kevin please don't flip the BGP prep until we run canary in 2 nodes. I can do canary Friday.

devops-bot: deploy scheduled: infra/route-policy v3 -> canary on 2025-09-05T12:00Z

morgan: attaching manifest in the ticket now. Also note storage in ap-southeast-2 is configured w/ SSE-KMS, key arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-2:... (redacted).

kevin: noted re: canary. For DNS TTL change, propose lowering to 60s 1 hour before cutover.

anya: compliance ok with reduced TTL for migration only. Need confirmation that logs are stored in region and not replicated.

sam: I can run a quick script to assert region tags + replication. Will push runbook.

sam: ```sh
# check S3 replication status
aws s3api get-bucket-replication --bucket redwood-apac-logs || echo 'no replication'
```

liz: +1 on runbook, dropping link to playbook: https://docs.redwood.com/playbooks/region-rollout (internal). I'll review after canary.

anya: timeline check — do we have oncall handover for that UTC window? @kevin

kevin: yep I'll be oncall that window. @morgan please add me to the incident rota.

morgan: done. I'll also open a short PR to config repo for routing policy tweak. @liz please review: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1987

liz: will review tomorrow morning PST. If no blockers, can approve.

kevin: one more — we need fallback to global pool if capacity low. proposed config snippet:

kevin: ```yaml
routing:
  prefer_region: true
  fallback: global
  max_latency_ms: 250
```

morgan: perfect. Thanks all — please add any outstanding blockers to INFR-624. We'll do final dry run Mon 02:00 UTC. :rocket: (reaction :eyes:)
